group.description: Models Eclipse commands and commandId references (handlers, key bindings, menu contributions) and flags references to commands that are not declared in any scanned bundle.

concept.description: Labels <command> elements declared under an <extension point="org.eclipse.ui.commands"> as :Eclipse:Command, extracts the id into commandId, and creates DECLARES_COMMAND relationships from the declaring bundle.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:DECLARES_EXTENSION]->(ext:Eclipse:Extension) WHERE ext.point = 'org.eclipse.ui.commands' MATCH (ext)-[:HAS_ELEMENT]->(cmd:Xml:Element {name: 'command'}) -[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(idAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'id'}) WHERE idAttr.value IS NOT NULL AND idAttr.value <> '' SET cmd:Eclipse:Command, cmd.commandId = idAttr.value MERGE (bundle)-[:DECLARES_COMMAND]->(cmd) RETURN bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS Bundle, cmd.commandId AS CommandId ORDER BY Bundle, CommandId

concept.description: Labels any extension descendant element carrying a `commandId` attribute as :Eclipse:CommandReference (setting commandId), and creates REFERENCES_COMMAND relationships to the matching :Eclipse:Command. Command ids are resolved globally across all scanned bundles, matching the Eclipse command service.
concept.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:DECLARES_EXTENSION]->(ext:Eclipse:Extension) -[:HAS_ELEMENT*1..6]->(refEl:Xml:Element) -[:HAS_ATTRIBUTE]->(cidAttr:Xml:Attribute {name: 'commandId'}) WHERE cidAttr.value IS NOT NULL AND cidAttr.value <> '' SET refEl:Eclipse:CommandReference, refEl.commandId = cidAttr.value WITH refEl OPTIONAL MATCH (cmd:Eclipse:Command) WHERE cmd.commandId = refEl.commandId FOREACH (_ IN CASE WHEN cmd IS NULL THEN [] ELSE [1] END | MERGE (refEl)-[:REFERENCES_COMMAND]->(cmd)) RETURN DISTINCT refEl.commandId AS CommandId, count(cmd) AS ResolvedTargets ORDER BY CommandId

constraint.description: Finds `commandId` references (from handlers, key bindings, or menu contributions) that do not resolve to any :Eclipse:Command declared in the scanned bundles. A mistyped or stale commandId silently disables the referencing handler, binding, or menu item.
constraint.cypher: MATCH (bundle:Osgi:Bundle)-[:DECLARES_EXTENSION]->(ext:Eclipse:Extension) -[:HAS_ELEMENT*1..6]->(refEl:Eclipse:CommandReference) WHERE NOT (refEl)-[:REFERENCES_COMMAND]->(:Eclipse:Command) AND bundle:Osgi:Analyzed RETURN DISTINCT bundle.bundleSymbolicName AS Bundle, ext.point AS ReferencingPoint, refEl.commandId AS UnresolvedCommandId ORDER BY Bundle, UnresolvedCommandId
